from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha
root=Path.cwd();r=root/"runs/legal_openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03";base=root/"artifacts/research/openexempt_legal_scope_20261020";read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text())
cfg=read(root/"configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.json");rows=read(root/cfg["input_packet"])["rows"]
bank=[];latest={};results=[];noop=0;members=set()
for batch in range(1,6):
 records_path=r/f"batches/b{batch}_prequential_records.json";pub_path=r/f"publications/b{batch}.json"
 first=read(records_path)["skills"];publication=read(pub_path);seen=[x for x in rows if x["batch"]<=batch]
 current_ids={x["case_id"] for x in first};observations={**latest,**{(x["case_id"],x["family"]):x for x in first}}
 assert len(observations)==batch*32
 members.update((str(records_path.relative_to(root)),str(pub_path.relative_to(root))))
 for attempt,d in enumerate(publication["training_decisions"],1):
  if d.get("explicit_noop"):noop+=1;continue
  assert d.get("attempt_parent_bank_sha256")==csha(bank),(batch,attempt,"wrong actual parent")
  if "actual_replay" not in d:raise ValueError((batch,attempt,"unexpected non-replayed decision"))
  proposed_bank=d["proposed_bank"];proposal=d.get("proposed_replay",d["actual_replay"])
  assert {(x["case_id"],x["family"]) for x in proposal}==set(observations)
  coordinates=e.legal_edit_coordinates(bank,proposed_bank,seen)
  assert coordinates==d["legal_edit_coordinates"]
  parent=list(observations.values())
  cut=lambda rr,old:[x for x in rr if (x["case_id"] not in current_ids)==old]
  recomputed=e.legal_scope_admission(coordinates,cut(parent,False),cut(proposal,False),cut(parent,True),cut(proposal,True))
  assert csha(recomputed)==csha(d["legal_scope_admission"])
  candidatepath=r/f"candidates/b{batch}_candidate{attempt}.json";assert candidatepath.exists()
  members.add(str(candidatepath.relative_to(root)))
  for co in coordinates:
   f=co["task"];scope=set(co["jurisdictions"]);ids=set(co["source_case_ids"])
   projection=lambda b:[x for x in e.task_view(b,f) if x["guidance"]["jurisdiction"] in scope]
   if projection(bank)==projection(proposed_bank):continue
   groups=[[x for x in rr if x["family"]==f and x["case_id"] in ids] for rr in (cut(parent,False),cut(proposal,False),cut(parent,True),cut(proposal,True))]
   means=[e.metrics(g).get(f) for g in groups];a,b,pa,pb=means;actual=recomputed[co["id"]]
   ceiling=bool(a) and abs(a["f1"]-1)<=1e-12 and abs(a["full_output_f1"]-1)<=1e-12 and a["negative_or_unscored_asset_claims"]==0 and a["invalid_format"]==0
   prior_strict=bool(pa) and (pb["f1"]>pa["f1"]+1e-12 or pb["full_output_f1"]>pa["full_output_f1"]+1e-12 or any(pb[k]<pa[k] for k in ("negative_or_unscored_asset_claims","invalid_format")))
   nonreg_names=[k for k in actual if k.endswith("nonregression")]
   all_nonreg=bool(a) and all(actual[k] for k in nonreg_names)
   variant=bool(a) and all_nonreg and (actual["strict_current_improvement"] or prior_strict)
   actual_drops={name:False for name in ("current_native","current_full","prior_native","prior_full")}
   if a:actual_drops.update({"current_native":b["f1"]+1e-12<a["f1"],"current_full":b["full_output_f1"]+1e-12<a["full_output_f1"]})
   if pa:actual_drops.update({"prior_native":pb["f1"]+1e-12<pa["f1"],"prior_full":pb["full_output_f1"]+1e-12<pa["full_output_f1"]})
   results.append({"batch":batch,"attempt":attempt,"coordinate":co["id"],"current_sources":len(groups[0]),"prior_sources":len(groups[2]),"actual_coordinate_accepted":actual["accepted"],"actual_whole_decision_accepted":d["accepted"],"actual_gate":actual,"parent_current":a,"proposal_current":b,"parent_prior":pa,"proposal_prior":pb,"actual_parent_current_at_theoretical_best":ceiling,"strict_prior_improvement_observed":prior_strict,"same_nonregression_current_OR_prior_strict_would_accept_this_coordinate":variant,"only_current_strictness_blocks_observed_nonregressing_historical_gain":bool(variant and not actual["accepted"]),"score_decreases":actual_drops,"declared_counterfactual_boundary":"One actual historical proposal at its real parent. Not a simulated alternate learning trajectory, unseen-case gain, significance or proposed numerical tolerance."})
  if d["accepted"]:
   bank=d["candidate"];observations={(x["case_id"],x["family"]):x for x in d["actual_replay"]}
 assert csha(bank)==publication["bank_sha256"],(batch,"final parent mismatch")
 latest=observations
